instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: On LP gain: destroy 1 opp monster. Aroma +3000 LP: pay diff; destroy opp up to ATK. If you gain LP: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy it. If you control an Aroma monster and your LP is at least 3000 higher than your opponent's: You can pay LP equal to the difference; destroy face-up monsters your opponent controls whose combined ATK is less than or equal to the LP you paid to activate this effect. You can only use each effect of Dried Winds once per turn.
